content.cast.lantern-and-oil.tobi.0.bark.0: 你往下看了吗？我老是往下看。我不该看。
content.cast.lantern-and-oil.tobi.0.bark.1: 奥鲁说梯子会越爬越容易。可还没有。
content.cast.lantern-night.hessel.0.bark.0: 今晚木板撑住了。我数过了。
content.cast.lantern-night.hessel.0.bark.1: 树顶一亮，我们就跟着点灯。家家户户，年年如此。
content.cast.lantern-night.neve.0.bark.1: 告诉赫塞尔，今晚绳子挺住了。证明不了什么，但跟他说一声吧。
content.cast.lantern-night.oru.0.bark.0: 三十年都是我爬上去的。今晚我看着。这样也好。
content.cast.lantern-night.oru.0.bark.1: 把它挂到最顶上的铁钩上。到那儿就能看见钩子。
content.cast.lantern-night.tobi.0.bark.0: 我在这儿就能看见梯子。我不上去。你告诉我上面什么样。
content.cast.lantern-night.tobi.0.bark.1: 大灯笼亮了，就轮到我点我们家的灯了。
content.cast.the-ask.hessel.0.bark.0: 我爷爷那时候，客人来了都带礼物。你们带了好靴子。这就行了。
content.cast.the-ask.hessel.0.bark.1: 榨油机慢，我也慢。但总弄得完。
content.cast.the-ask.neve.0.bark.0: 灯罩差不多干了。奥鲁会派人来取的。
content.cast.the-ask.neve.0.bark.1: 当心晾布绳。那红布染了三天呢。
content.cast.the-flame.hessel.0.bark.0: 那个油壶满到瓶口了。我检查了两遍。
content.cast.the-flame.hessel.0.bark.1: 当心低桥上从火塘屋那头数第三块木板，它软了。内芙说是绳子的毛病。
content.cast.the-flame.neve.0.bark.0: 去吧。点灯的是奥鲁，不是我。
content.cast.the-flame.neve.0.bark.1: 拿直了。一歪灯罩就烤焦。
content.cast.the-flame.tobi.0.bark.0: 点着了吗？我在下面看不见。
content.cast.the-flame.tobi.0.bark.1: 点着以后，奥鲁让我往我们家挂第一盏灯。
content.cast.the-gate.hessel.0.bark.0: 点着了？好。我的油，她的灯罩，奥鲁的火。
content.cast.the-gate.hessel.0.bark.1: 要上瞭望树了？我这膝盖还记得它呢。当心最顶上。
content.cast.the-gate.oru.0.bark.0: 内芙看见灯点着了就会解开门。去吧。
content.cast.the-gate.oru.0.bark.1: 我就在这儿看着。今晚这里就是我的位置。
content.cast.the-gate.tobi.0.bark.0: 点着了！我在这儿就看见了。
content.cast.the-gate.tobi.0.bark.1: 你们要爬瞭望树，一直爬到顶？一整棵？
content.class.guest.blurb: 部族在灯笼夜收留的旅人：一双好靴子，一点吃的，没有武器。
content.class.guest.kit.0.name: 坚果面包
content.class.guest.kit.2.name: 好靴子
content.class.guest.name: 氏族宾客
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-built.opt.0.label: 谢谢。
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-built.opt.1.label: 那座桥安全吗？
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-built.text: 一棵一棵地来。先建起火塘树，那是我爷爷的奶奶家。接着是织机树，他们砍掉树顶，腾出块平地织布。然后才是这一棵，种子树。瞭望树最后建，因为总得有人能看见天气要来。
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-oil.opt.0.label: 谢谢。
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-oil.opt.1.label: 那座桥安全吗？
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-oil.opt.2.label: 谁建了这一切？
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-oil.text: 要灯油？上周用今年的坚果榨的。来，满满一壶。
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-quarrel.opt.0.label: 谢谢。
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-quarrel.opt.1.label: 谁建了这一切？
content.dlg.hessel.hessel-quarrel.text: 内芙会跟你说绳子不行了。绳子没问题，是木板。我在上面走了六十年，哪块软了我一踩就知道。你要是见到她，就告诉她这话。
content.dlg.neve.neve-gate-about.opt.0.label: 谢谢。
content.dlg.neve.neve-gate-about.opt.1.label: 那座桥安全吗？
content.dlg.neve.neve-gate-about.text: 那是通往瞭望树的高桥。我把它系着，等灯笼点亮。老规矩，我喜欢。
content.dlg.neve.neve-gate.opt.0.label: 解开绳门
content.dlg.neve.neve-gate.text: 点亮了。奥鲁的火苗在我织的罩子里，年年一样。门这就开。
content.dlg.neve.neve-lantern.opt.0.label: 谢谢。
content.dlg.neve.neve-lantern.opt.1.label: 那道门是什么？
content.dlg.neve.neve-lantern.opt.2.label: 那座桥安全吗？
content.dlg.neve.neve-lantern.text: 奥鲁叫你来取灯笼？给。灯罩是今年的新布，这周刚下织机。
content.dlg.neve.neve-quarrel.opt.0.label: 谢谢。
content.dlg.neve.neve-quarrel.text: 高桥没事。去赫塞尔家的低桥得换新绳子。赫塞尔说是木板的问题，其实是绳子。见到他，告诉他是我说的。
content.dlg.neve.neve-untied.opt.0.label: 上去吧
content.dlg.neve.neve-untied.text: 好了。高桥通往瞭望屋。从那儿起全是梯子，一直到顶。把灯笼挂在最顶上的铁钩上。
content.dlg.oru.oru-ask.opt.0.label: 灯笼夜是什么？
content.dlg.oru.oru-ask.text: 欢迎来到火塘屋。我是奥鲁，守着这方火塘。你们来得正好：今晚是灯笼夜。
content.dlg.oru.oru-errand.opt.0.label: 两样都带来
content.dlg.oru.oru-errand.text: 谢谢。内芙是营地的织工，新灯笼在织屋，过了长桥就是。赫塞尔是种子保管人，灯油在种子屋，过了低桥就是。两样都带来，我在火塘边点亮。
content.dlg.oru.oru-knee.opt.0.label: 我们拿上去
content.dlg.oru.oru-knee.text: 今年我的膝盖爬不了梯子了。我很难过，我不想装没事。你们能替我把灯笼拿上去吗？
content.dlg.oru.oru-light.opt.0.label: 都在这儿
content.dlg.oru.oru-lit.opt.0.label: 去内芙那儿
content.dlg.oru.oru-lit.text: 油是赫塞尔的，灯罩是内芙的，火取自这火塘，年年如此。好了，点亮了。拿去给内芙。她看见灯笼亮着，就会解开高桥的门，高桥通往瞭望树。
content.dlg.oru.oru-night.opt.0.label: 那今年呢？
content.dlg.oru.oru-night.text: 每年一次，等坚果榨好、新布织成，我们就在瞭望树顶挂一盏新灯笼，瞭望树是营地里最高的树。灯笼一亮，家家户户都点起自己的灯回应。我亲手把它拿上去点亮，已经三十年了。
content.dlg.oru.oru-waiting.opt.0.label: 我们很快回来
content.dlg.oru.oru-waiting.text: 灯笼在内芙的织屋，过了长桥就是。灯油在赫塞尔的种子屋，过了低桥就是。先去哪边都行。
content.dlg.tobi.tobi-ladder.opt.0.label: 我们先上
content.dlg.tobi.tobi-ladder.text: 绳梯挂在树干上，十四节。我天天爬，还是怕。你们先上，等你们到了我再上。
content.dlg.tobi.tobi-root.opt.0.label: 我们怎么上去？
content.dlg.tobi.tobi-root.opt.1.label: 我们上去
content.dlg.tobi.tobi-root.text: 你们是客人！我是托比。奥鲁让我下来接你们。她就在上面的火塘屋等着，就是我们头顶那个大平台。
content.fx.lantern-night.done.0.seq.11.0.narrate: 营地里，家家户户都点起了灯回应。
content.fx.trig.gate-tied.0.narrate: 绳门系着，织工等灯笼点亮才会解开。

content.npc.oru.name: 奥鲁

content.obj.lantern-and-oil.fetch-the-lantern.hi: 从火塘屋过长桥，到织屋去。
content.obj.lantern-and-oil.fetch-the-oil.hint: 从火塘屋过低桥，到种子屋去。
content.obj.lantern-and-oil.fetch-the-oil.title: 找赫塞尔拿灯油
content.obj.lantern-night.climb-to-the-lookout.h: 从织屋出发，过高桥，再沿梯子爬上瞭望树。
content.obj.lantern-night.hang-the-lantern.hint: 铁钩挂在树顶木环台的上方。
content.obj.lantern-night.hang-the-lantern.missi: 手里拿着夜灯笼才能挂到钩上。
content.obj.lantern-night.hang-the-lantern.title: 把灯挂到钩上
content.obj.the-ask.hear-oru.hint: 沿火塘树树干上的绳梯爬到上面的平台。
content.obj.the-ask.hear-oru.title: 爬到奥鲁那里
content.obj.the-ask.meet-tobi.hint: 他在火塘树树干上的绳梯脚下等着。
content.obj.the-ask.meet-tobi.title: 和托比说话
content.obj.the-flame.light-the-lantern.hint: 奥鲁在火塘屋的火塘边等着。
content.obj.the-flame.light-the-lantern.title: 把两样都带给奥鲁
content.obj.the-gate.show-neve.title: 把点亮的灯拿给内芙看
content.quest.lantern-and-oil.goal: 去织屋找内芙拿新灯，去种子屋找赫塞尔拿灯油。
content.quest.lantern-night.goal: 带着点亮的灯爬上瞭望树，挂到树顶。
content.quest.the-ask.goal: 爬上火塘屋，听听奥鲁要你做什么。
content.quest.the-flame.goal: 把灯和油带回给奥鲁，在火塘边点亮。
content.quest.the-gate.goal: 把点亮的灯给内芙看，让她解开高桥的绳门。
content.world.outro: 灯笼夜：灯笼在瞭望树顶亮着，营地里每间屋子都回应了它。
content.world.title: 树屋营地

source.cast.lantern-and-oil.tobi.0.bark.0: Did you look down? I always look down. I shouldn't.
source.cast.lantern-and-oil.tobi.0.bark.1: Oru says the ladder gets easier. It hasn't yet.
source.cast.lantern-night.hessel.0.bark.0: The planks held tonight. I counted them.
source.cast.lantern-night.hessel.0.bark.1: When the top is lit, we answer. Every house, every year.
source.cast.lantern-night.neve.0.bark.0: Go on up. The High Bridge is open.
source.cast.lantern-night.neve.0.bark.1: Tell Hessel the rope held tonight. It proves nothing, but tell him.
source.cast.lantern-night.oru.0.bark.0: Thirty years I climbed it. Tonight I watch. That is all right.
source.cast.lantern-night.oru.0.bark.1: Hang it on the iron hook at the very top. You will see the hook.
source.cast.lantern-night.tobi.0.bark.0: I can see the ladder from here. I'm not going up it. Tell me what it's like.
source.cast.lantern-night.tobi.0.bark.1: When the big lantern's lit, I get to light ours.
source.cast.the-ask.hessel.0.bark.0: In my grandfather's day, guests brought gifts. You brought good boots. That will do.
source.cast.the-ask.hessel.0.bark.1: The press is slow, and so am I. We get there.
source.cast.the-ask.neve.0.bark.0: The shade is nearly dry. Oru will send someone for it.
source.cast.the-ask.neve.0.bark.1: Mind the cloth lines. That red is three days of dyeing.
source.cast.the-flame.hessel.0.bark.0: That flask is full to the top. I checked twice.
source.cast.the-flame.hessel.0.bark.1: Mind the third plank from the Hearth end. It is soft. Neve says it is the rope.
source.cast.the-flame.neve.0.bark.0: Go on. Oru lights it, not me.
source.cast.the-flame.neve.0.bark.1: Carry it upright. The shade scorches if it tips.
source.cast.the-flame.tobi.0.bark.0: Is it lit yet? I can't see from down here.
source.cast.the-flame.tobi.0.bark.1: When it's lit, Oru lets me hang the first lantern on our house.
source.cast.the-gate.hessel.0.bark.0: Lit? Good. My oil, her shade, Oru's fire.
source.cast.the-gate.hessel.0.bark.1: Up the Watch Tree, is it? My knees remember it. Mind the top.
source.cast.the-gate.oru.0.bark.0: Neve will untie the gate when she sees it lit. Go on.
source.cast.the-gate.oru.0.bark.1: I will watch from here. That is my place tonight.
source.cast.the-gate.tobi.0.bark.0: It's lit! I saw it from here.
source.cast.the-gate.tobi.0.bark.1: You're going all the way up the Watch Tree? All of it?
source.class.guest.blurb: A traveller the clan has taken in for Lantern Night: good boots, a little food, nothing to fight with.
source.class.guest.kit.0.name: Nut Bread
source.class.guest.kit.2.name: Good Boots
source.class.guest.name: Guest of the Clan
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-built.opt.0.label: Thank you.
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-built.opt.1.label: Is that bridge safe?
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-built.text: One tree at a time. The Hearth Tree first, my grandfather's grandmother's house. Then the Loom Tree, and they cut its top off for a flat place to weave. Then this one, the Seed Tree. The Watch Tree last, because somebody had to see the weather coming.
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-oil.opt.0.label: Thank you.
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-oil.opt.1.label: Is that bridge safe?
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-oil.opt.2.label: Who built all this?
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-oil.text: Oil for the lantern? Pressed last week from this year's nuts. Here, a full flask.
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-quarrel.opt.0.label: Thank you.
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-quarrel.opt.1.label: Who built all this?
source.dlg.hessel.hessel-quarrel.text: Neve will tell you the rope is going. The rope is fine. It's the planks. I have walked them sixty years and I can feel which ones are soft. If you see her, you can tell her that.
source.dlg.neve.neve-gate-about.opt.0.label: Thank you.
source.dlg.neve.neve-gate-about.opt.1.label: Is that bridge safe?
source.dlg.neve.neve-gate-about.text: That's the High Bridge, to the Watch Tree. I keep it tied until the lantern is lit. It's an old rule, and I like it.
source.dlg.neve.neve-gate.opt.0.label: Untie the gate.
source.dlg.neve.neve-gate.text: It's lit. Oru's flame in my shade, same as every year. Then the gate comes open.
source.dlg.neve.neve-lantern.opt.0.label: Thank you.
source.dlg.neve.neve-lantern.opt.1.label: What is that gate?
source.dlg.neve.neve-lantern.opt.2.label: Is that bridge safe?
source.dlg.neve.neve-lantern.text: Oru sent you for the lantern? Here. The shade is this year's cloth, off the loom this week.
source.dlg.neve.neve-quarrel.opt.0.label: Thank you.
source.dlg.neve.neve-quarrel.text: The High Bridge is fine. The Low Bridge, to Hessel's, needs new rope. Hessel says it's the planks. It's the rope. If you see him, tell him I said so.
source.dlg.neve.neve-untied.opt.0.label: Up we go.
source.dlg.neve.neve-untied.text: There. The High Bridge goes to the Watch House. From there it's ladders, all the way to the top. Hang it on the iron hook at the very top.
source.dlg.oru.oru-ask.opt.0.label: What is Lantern Night?
source.dlg.oru.oru-ask.text: Welcome to the Hearth House. I am Oru, and I keep this hearth. You came on a good night: tonight is Lantern Night.
source.dlg.oru.oru-errand.opt.0.label: We'll bring both.
source.dlg.oru.oru-errand.text: Thank you. Neve is the camp's weaver: she has the new lantern at the Loom House, across the Long Bridge. Hessel is the seed-keeper: he keeps the lamp oil at the Seed House, across the Low Bridge. Bring me both, and I will light it here at the hearth.
source.dlg.oru.oru-knee.opt.0.label: We'll carry it.
source.dlg.oru.oru-knee.text: This year my knee will not take the ladder. I am sad about it, and I would rather say so than pretend I am not. Will you carry the lantern up for me?
source.dlg.oru.oru-light.opt.0.label: Here they are.
source.dlg.oru.oru-light.text: The lantern and the oil. Give them here.
source.dlg.oru.oru-lit.opt.0.label: To Neve, then.
source.dlg.oru.oru-lit.text: The oil is Hessel's, the shade is Neve's, and the flame is from this hearth, as it is every year. There: it is lit. Take it to Neve. When she sees it burning, she will untie the gate to the High Bridge, and the High Bridge goes to the Watch Tree.
source.dlg.oru.oru-night.opt.0.label: And this year?
source.dlg.oru.oru-night.text: Once a year, when the nuts are pressed and the new cloth is woven, we hang a new lantern at the top of the Watch Tree, the tallest tree in the camp. When it is lit, every house answers with lanterns of its own. I have carried it up and lit it for thirty years.
source.dlg.oru.oru-waiting.opt.0.label: We'll be back.
source.dlg.oru.oru-waiting.text: The lantern is with Neve at the Loom House, across the Long Bridge. The oil is with Hessel at the Seed House, across the Low Bridge. Either first.
source.dlg.tobi.tobi-ladder.opt.0.label: We'll go first.
source.dlg.tobi.tobi-ladder.text: The rope ladder, on the trunk. Fourteen rungs. I climb it every day and I'm still afraid of it. You go first, and I'll come when you're up.
source.dlg.tobi.tobi-root.opt.0.label: How do we get up?
source.dlg.tobi.tobi-root.opt.1.label: We'll go up.
source.dlg.tobi.tobi-root.text: You're the guests! I'm Tobi. Oru sent me down to fetch you. She's waiting up in the Hearth House, on the big platform over our heads.
source.fx.lantern-night.done.0.seq.11.0.narrate: Down in the camp, every house has answered the lantern.
source.fx.trig.gate-tied.0.narrate: The rope gate is knotted shut. The weaver unties it when the lantern is lit.

source.obj.lantern-and-oil.fetch-the-lantern.hi: Cross the Long Bridge from the Hearth House to the Loom House.
source.obj.lantern-and-oil.fetch-the-oil.hint: Cross the Low Bridge from the Hearth House to the Seed House.
source.obj.lantern-and-oil.fetch-the-oil.title: Fetch lamp oil from Hessel
source.obj.lantern-night.climb-to-the-lookout.h: Cross the High Bridge from the Loom House, then climb the ladders up the Watch Tree.
source.obj.lantern-night.climb-to-the-lookout.t: Climb to the top of the Watch Tree
source.obj.lantern-night.hang-the-lantern.hint: The iron hook hangs over the ring at the top of the tree.
source.obj.lantern-night.hang-the-lantern.missi: Hold the Night Lantern in your hand to hang it on the hook.
source.obj.lantern-night.hang-the-lantern.title: Hang the lantern on the hook
source.obj.the-ask.hear-oru.hint: Climb the rope ladder on the Hearth Tree's trunk to the platform above.
source.obj.the-ask.hear-oru.title: Climb up to Oru
source.obj.the-ask.meet-tobi.hint: He waits at the foot of the rope ladder on the great trunk.
source.obj.the-ask.meet-tobi.title: Speak to Tobi
source.obj.the-flame.light-the-lantern.hint: Oru waits by the hearth in the Hearth House.
source.obj.the-flame.light-the-lantern.title: Bring both to Oru
source.obj.the-gate.show-neve.hint: Cross the Long Bridge back to the Loom House.
source.obj.the-gate.show-neve.title: Show Neve the lit lantern
source.quest.lantern-and-oil.goal: Fetch the new lantern from Neve at the Loom House and lamp oil from Hessel at the Seed House.
source.quest.lantern-night.goal: Carry the lit lantern up the Watch Tree and hang it at the top.
source.quest.the-ask.goal: Climb up to the Hearth House and hear what Oru asks of you.
source.quest.the-flame.goal: Bring the lantern and the oil back to Oru to be lit at the hearth.
source.quest.the-gate.goal: Show Neve the lit lantern so she unties the High Bridge gate.
source.world.outro: Lantern Night: the lantern burns at the top of the Watch Tree, and every house in the camp has answered it.
source.world.title: The Treehouse Camp
